notes.title: Five Nights with Froggy is ten years now!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41218393/1937743333747899a9ec2d2e4e758977134cc0a6.png[/img]
Exactly ten years have passed since the release of the first version of the game, but the story of this game does not end. Thank you for playing this game for the past decade and for following its news.

P. S. Collection of classic versions of FNwFroggy was released for 10th anniversary of FNwFroggy.

notes.title: Five Nights with Froggy — Coming to Steam
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41218393/273bab1030a4809838a39dca73f6e5f7735f6f3f.png[/img]
You heard it right, the game about scary toys and guarding the royal garden is coming to Steam.

The game will be released on Steam alongside update 4.1, but while it's not out yet, add it to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3523150/Five_Nights_with_Froggy

[h2]What features will be added in update 4.1?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Challenges
[*] Random Night
[*] New Languages
[/list]

[h2]Will other parts of the series be released on Steam?[/h2]
Yes, the next two parts of the game will also be released on Steam. Pages for them are planned to be launched soon.

[h2]Will the Steam edition be paid?[/h2]
Yes, the game will be paid on Steam (as well as on VK Play).

[h2]How much will the paid edition cost?[/h2]
Around 1.99-2.99 dollars.

[h2]What's the difference between the paid and free versions?[/h2]
The paid edition will include a special addition related to paid bonuses from the mobile version of the game, but they will be added in a more interesting and balanced way than in the mobile version. More information will be revealed closer to the release.

[h2]Will free versions receive updates alongside the paid edition?[/h2]
Yes, all versions of the game will receive the same fixes and content updates. For example, update 4.1 with challenges, a new mode, and new languages will be released for both the paid and free versions.
